tagline.zh: 從交班到最後一台刀——簡單的闌尾，從來不簡單
tagline.en: From handover to the last case: the simple appendix never is

desc.zh: 第一次跟一般外科的刀。扶鏡、寫紀錄、接病房電話，什麼都要學。
desc.en: Your first week scrubbing in general surgery: hold the camera, write the notes, answer the ward phone.

desc.zh: 器械台是你的領土。清點、遞器械、標本標示，少一塊紗布刀就不能關。
desc.en: The instrument table is your territory: counts, passing instruments, labelling specimens. One missing swab and nobody closes.

about.zh: 刀快話少，教人只用問句。桌上永遠有一杯沒喝完的咖啡。
about.en: Fast hands, few words, teaches only in questions. There is always an unfinished coffee on the desk.

about.zh: 值了一整夜還在笑。白板是他的第二本病歷。
about.en: Still smiling after a night on call. The whiteboard is his second set of notes.

about.zh: 坐在布簾另一邊，看得比誰都清楚。
about.en: Sits on the other side of the drape and sees more than anyone.

about.zh: 開刀房的管家。時間暫停由她喊，清點由她核。
about.en: Housekeeper of the theatre. She calls the time-out and verifies the counts.

about.zh: 後天期中考。昨晚開始右下腹痛，一直問能不能今天出院。
about.en: Mid-terms the day after tomorrow. Right lower abdominal pain since last night; keeps asking to go home today.

role.zh: 病人・52 歲早餐店老闆娘

about.zh: 右上腹痛三天還在煎蛋餅，發燒了才肯來。最擔心明天的早餐攤。
about.en: Three days of right upper abdominal pain and still flipping egg crêpes; came in only when the fever started. Worries about tomorrow's shop.

about.zh: 病房的眼睛。她打電話來，通常有道理。
about.en: The ward's eyes. When she phones, there is usually a reason.

about.zh: 在門口等了一早上，手裡握著兒子的學生證。
about.en: Waited by the door all morning, holding her son's student card.

plain.zh: 劃刀前全隊停下來，大聲核對病人、部位、手術名稱與過敏。
plain.en: Before the incision the whole team stops and confirms the patient, the site, the operation and allergies out loud.

plain.zh: 右下腹肚臍與骨盆前上棘連線外三分之一處，闌尾炎最典型的壓痛位置。
plain.en: A spot in the right lower abdomen, a third of the way from the hip bone to the navel, where appendicitis typically hurts to press.

plain.zh: 把二氧化碳打進腹腔撐出空間，腹腔鏡才看得到、動得了。
plain.en: Carbon dioxide blown into the abdomen to make room so the laparoscope can see and the instruments can move.

plain.zh: 闌尾連到盲腸的地方。切除要在這裡處理乾淨，否則會漏。
plain.en: Where the appendix joins the caecum. It must be closed securely here, or it leaks.

plain.zh: 切下來要送病理檢查的組織，罐子上一定要有姓名、病歷號與部位。
plain.en: Tissue removed for the pathologist; the pot must carry the name, record number and site.

plain.zh: 開刀前、關閉前、關完後，紗布、針、器械要數到一樣，才可以關。
plain.en: Swabs, needles and instruments are counted before the operation, before closing and after; the numbers must match before anyone closes.

plain.zh: 急性膽囊炎的嚴重度分級，依局部發炎、全身反應與器官功能分成三級。
plain.en: A severity grading for acute cholecystitis in three grades, based on local inflammation, systemic response and organ function.

plain.zh: 腹腔鏡膽囊切除前的三個條件：清掉三角脂肪、膽囊離開肝床、只剩兩條結構進膽囊。
plain.en: Three conditions before cutting anything in a gallbladder operation: fat cleared from the triangle, gallbladder freed from the liver bed, only two structures entering it.

plain.zh: 膽管被結石塞住又感染，發燒、黃疸、右上腹痛，會很快變成敗血症，要盡快引流。
plain.en: A blocked, infected bile duct: fever, jaundice and right upper abdominal pain that can turn into sepsis fast; it needs drainage soon.

plain.zh: 電話報告的順序：身分、情境、背景、評估、建議。讓對方三十秒內知道該做什麼。
plain.en: The order for a phone report: identity, situation, background, assessment, recommendation, so the listener knows what to do within thirty seconds.

plain.zh: 腹腔鏡做不安全時改成傳統開腹，是判斷力，不是失敗。
plain.en: Switching from keyhole to an open operation when keyhole is not safe. It is judgement, not failure.

plain.zh: 麻醉醒來的地方，護理師盯著呼吸、血壓與疼痛，穩定了才回病房。
plain.en: Where patients wake from anaesthesia, watched for breathing, blood pressure and pain before going back to the ward.

text.zh: 光源、攝影機、螢幕與錄影疊成一座塔。鏡頭的畫面就是整間房的眼睛。
text.en: Light source, camera unit, screen and recorder stacked in one tower. The camera picture is the whole room's eyes.

text.zh: 把二氧化碳打進腹腔並維持壓力的機器。壓力與流量依醫囑與機器設定。
text.en: Pumps carbon dioxide into the abdomen and holds the pressure. Pressure and flow follow the protocol and the machine's settings.

text.zh: 用電流切割與止血。回路貼片要貼在肌肉多的地方，離金屬植入物遠一點。
text.en: Cuts and seals with electric current. The return pad goes on a muscular area, away from metal implants.

text.zh: 把小金屬夾夾在膽囊管與膽囊動脈上。看清楚是什麼，才夾。
text.en: Places small metal clips on the cystic duct and artery. Know what it is before you clip it.

text.zh: 膽囊炎的第一線影像：看膽囊壁、周圍積液、結石與壓痛。
text.en: First-line imaging for cholecystitis: wall thickness, fluid around the gallbladder, stones and tenderness under the probe.

text.zh: 裝在標本袋裡拉出來的闌尾，泡在福馬林裡送病理。標籤：姓名、病歷號、部位、日期。
text.en: The appendix, retrieved in a bag and sent to pathology in formalin. Label: name, record number, site, date.

text.zh: 紗布、針、器械的數目三次核對的紀錄。數不對，刀不關，先找，再照 X 光。
text.en: The record of three counts of swabs, needles and instruments. If the numbers disagree nobody closes: search first, then X-ray.

text.zh: 不是一個角度，是三個條件同時成立。做不到就換策略：膽道攝影、次全切除或轉開腹。
text.en: Not a camera angle but three conditions met together. If you cannot get it, change strategy: cholangiogram, subtotal cholecystectomy or conversion.

lines.zh: 早。昨晚兩台急刀，我快被白板吃掉了。
lines.en: Morning. Two emergencies overnight; the whiteboard nearly ate me.

lines.zh: 今天第一台小宇，19 歲，闌尾炎。下午王阿姨，膽囊炎。
lines.en: First case today is Yu, 19, appendicitis. This afternoon Mrs Wang, cholecystitis.

lines.zh: 還有 7 床疝氣術後，今早還沒排尿，幫我盯一下。
lines.en: And bed 7, post hernia repair, hasn't passed urine this morning. Keep an eye on him.

lines.zh: 收到。闌尾、膽囊、7 床。
lines.en: Got it. Appendix, gallbladder, bed 7.

lines.zh: 白板上：08:00 腹腔鏡闌尾切除；14:00 腹腔鏡膽囊切除。
lines.en: On the whiteboard: 08:00 laparoscopic appendicectomy; 14:00 laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

lines.zh: 早。小宇的評分看了嗎？
lines.en: Morning. Did you look at Yu's score?

lines.zh: Alvarado 高分，麥氏點壓痛，超音波也符合。
lines.en: High Alvarado score, tender at McBurney's point, ultrasound fits.

lines.zh: 評分是幫你想，不是幫你決定。檢驗與妊娠試驗呢？
lines.en: A score helps you think; it doesn't decide for you. Bloods and the pregnancy test?

lines.zh: 白血球高、CRP 高。男生，不用驗孕。
lines.en: White cells and CRP raised. He's male, so no pregnancy test.

lines.zh: 對，但每次都要問自己一次。
lines.en: Right, but ask yourself every single time.

lines.zh: 好。我去泡杯咖啡——先放著。
lines.en: Good. I'll make a coffee and leave it there.

lines.zh: 那杯咖啡會在桌上放一整天。
lines.en: That coffee will sit on the desk all day.

note.zh: 闌尾根部壞死，處理妥當

guide.zh: 核對身分，跟小宇聊兩句
guide.en: Check identity and talk to Yu

lines.zh: 醫師，我後天期中考……今天可以出院嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, my mid-terms are the day after tomorrow... can I go home today?

lines.zh: 先把闌尾處理好。姓名、生日、哪裡痛，再跟我說一次。
lines.en: Let's deal with the appendix first. Name, birthday and where it hurts, once more for me.

lines.zh: 右下腹，昨晚開始，按下去再放開更痛。
lines.en: Right lower side since last night. Worse when you let go than when you press.

lines.zh: 醫師，他從小怕打針。拜託你們了。
lines.en: Doctor, he's been scared of needles since he was small. Please look after him.

lines.zh: 阿姨，等一下恢復室見。您先坐。
lines.en: We'll see you in the recovery room. Please sit down for now.

lines.zh: 刷手台。指尖到手肘，水往手肘流，不要回頭碰水龍頭。
lines.en: The scrub sink. Fingertips to elbows, water running towards the elbows, never touch the tap again.

lines.zh: 新來的，順序說一遍再動手。
lines.en: New one: say the order before you start.

q.zh: 外科刷手與穿戴的正確順序
q.en: The correct order of scrubbing and gowning

lines.zh: 時間暫停。病人小宇，腹腔鏡闌尾切除，過敏無，抗生素依醫囑已給。
lines.en: Time-out. Patient Yu, laparoscopic appendicectomy, no allergies, antibiotics given per protocol.

lines.zh: 預期的問題？
lines.en: Anticipated problems?

lines.zh: 沒有特別的——但闌尾炎永遠有驚喜。
lines.en: Nothing specific. But appendicitis always has a surprise.

lines.zh: 麻醉這邊穩定，可以開始。
lines.en: Anaesthesia stable; you may start.

lines.zh: 開刀前器械清點。紗布、針、器械，你唸我核。
lines.en: Pre-op instrument count. Swabs, needles, instruments; you call, I verify.

lines.zh: 紗布十、針三、套管四、抓鉗兩支、施夾器一。
lines.en: Swabs ten, needles three, ports four, graspers two, clip applier one.

lines.zh: 數目正確。器械清點單簽名。
lines.en: Counts correct. Sign the count sheet.

q.zh: 點一下器械台，確認清點單放在那裡
q.en: Tap the instrument table to confirm the count sheet is there

lines.zh: 氣腹建好了。鏡頭進去，先看什麼？
lines.en: Pneumoperitoneum is in. Camera's in; what do you look at first?

lines.zh: 先全腹探查，再沿盲腸的結腸帶找到闌尾根部。
lines.en: Whole abdomen first, then follow the taenia of the caecum down to the appendix base.

lines.zh: 很好。咦——
lines.en: Good. Hm...

lines.zh: 螢幕上，闌尾根部的顏色不對：發黑、發軟。
lines.en: On the screen the appendix base looks wrong: dark and soft.

guide.en: Necrotic base: decide how to close it

lines.zh: 根部壞死到盲腸邊。你會怎麼關？
lines.en: The base is necrotic right up to the caecum. How would you close it?

q.zh: 闌尾根部壞死，最安全的處理？
q.en: The appendix base is necrotic. The safest way to close it?

options.zh: 縫合器切在健康的盲腸壁上

why.zh: 對。壞死的組織夾不住，要退到健康的盲腸壁才牢。
why.en: Right. Necrotic tissue won't hold; go back to healthy caecal wall.

options.zh: 直接用套圈結紮壞死處

why.zh: 套圈綁在壞死組織上會漏。等一下紀錄會寫成實際的處理。
why.en: A loop on necrotic tissue leaks. The note will record what was actually done.

options.zh: 什麼都不看，立刻轉開腹

why.zh: 轉開腹是備案，不是反射動作。先評估腹腔鏡下能不能安全處理。
why.en: Conversion is a backup plan, not a reflex. First assess whether it can be done safely by laparoscopy.

post.zh: 標本袋裝好再拉出來，不要讓它碰到傷口。
post.en: Into the retrieval bag before it comes out; don't let it touch the wound.

post.zh: 關閉前清點：紗布十、針三，數目正確。
post.en: Closing count: swabs ten, needles three, correct.

lines.zh: 手術紀錄你寫，我簽。根部怎麼處理的，寫實際做的。
lines.en: You write the op note, I sign. Record exactly how the base was dealt with.

lines.zh: 發現、處理、標本、清點、引流有無、術後指示。
lines.en: Findings, procedure, specimen, counts, drain or not, post-op instructions.

lines.zh: 還有一句：給下一個讀它的人看得懂。
lines.en: And one more thing: write it so the next reader understands.

lines.zh: 醫師！他還好嗎？
lines.en: Doctor! Is he all right?

lines.zh: 開完了，闌尾已經切掉。根部發炎得比較厲害，我們多做了一步。
lines.en: It's done; the appendix is out. The base was quite inflamed, so we took an extra step.

lines.zh: 那期中考……
lines.en: And his mid-terms...

lines.zh: 他醒來會先問這個。我們明天再談。
lines.en: That'll be his first question when he wakes. Let's talk tomorrow.

sub.zh: 7 床術後還沒排尿，肚子脹
sub.en: Bed 7 hasn't passed urine, abdomen distended

guide.zh: 接電話，然後去看 7 床
guide.en: Take the call, then see bed 7

lines.zh: 醫師，ISBAR：7 床，疝氣術後六小時沒尿，下腹脹，有點躁。
lines.en: Doctor, ISBAR: bed 7, six hours after hernia repair, no urine, lower abdomen distended, restless.

lines.zh: 生命徵象？膀胱掃描做了嗎？
lines.en: Vitals? Have you done a bladder scan?

lines.zh: 血壓心跳正常。掃描顯示膀胱很脹。
lines.en: Blood pressure and pulse fine. Scan shows a very full bladder.

lines.zh: 術後尿滯留。先試坐起、走動，不行就依醫囑導尿，記錄尿量。我過去。
lines.en: Post-op retention. Try sitting up and walking; if not, catheterise per protocol and record the volume. I'm coming.

lines.zh: 收到。對了，他一直問能不能回家煮飯。
lines.en: Got it. By the way, he keeps asking if he can go home and cook dinner.

note.zh: 王阿姨：膽囊炎 Tokyo 分級

guide.zh: 和林主治看王阿姨的超音波
guide.en: Review Mrs Wang's ultrasound with Dr Lin

lines.zh: 王阿姨，52 歲，右上腹痛三天，發燒。超音波你來報。
lines.en: Mrs Wang, 52, three days of right upper abdominal pain, fever. You present the ultrasound.

lines.zh: 先看膽囊壁、周圍有沒有積液、結石卡在哪裡。
lines.en: Gallbladder wall first, any fluid around it, where the stone is stuck.

question.zh: 超音波上急性膽囊炎的三個線索是什麼？
question.en: What are the three ultrasound clues to acute cholecystitis?

answer.zh: 膽囊壁增厚、膽囊周圍積液、結石嵌頓在頸部，加上探頭壓下去的超音波墨菲氏徵象。
answer.en: Thickened gallbladder wall, fluid around the gallbladder, a stone impacted at the neck, plus pain under the probe (sonographic Murphy's sign).

post.zh: 發燒、白血球高、局部腹膜炎，沒有器官衰竭。第二級。
post.en: Fever, raised white cells, local peritonism, no organ failure. Grade two.

post.zh: 桌上的咖啡已經冷了，一口都沒少。
post.en: The coffee on the desk has gone cold, untouched.

note.zh: 安全關鍵視野達成，一條膽管被救了
note.en: Critical view achieved; a bile duct saved

guide.en: See Mrs Wang before the case

lines.zh: 醫師，我店裡明天要出攤，明天能出院嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, the shop opens tomorrow. Can I be discharged tomorrow?

lines.zh: 先把膽囊拿掉，再談早餐店。您知道今天要做什麼手術嗎？
lines.en: Gallbladder first, breakfast shop after. Do you know what operation you're having today?

lines.zh: 腹腔鏡拿膽囊，四個小洞。同意書我簽了，我女兒說你們很厲害。
lines.en: Keyhole, take the gallbladder out, four small holes. I signed the consent; my daughter says you're very good.

lines.zh: 王阿姨，壓力給我們就好。
lines.en: Mrs Wang, leave the worrying to us.

lines.zh: 時間暫停：王阿姨，腹腔鏡膽囊切除，過敏無，設備已測。
lines.en: Time-out: Mrs Wang, laparoscopic cholecystectomy, no allergies, equipment checked.

lines.zh: 膽道攝影的 C 臂先叫好。不一定用，但要在。
lines.en: Have the C-arm ready for a cholangiogram. We may not use it, but it has to be there.

lines.zh: 你扶鏡。鏡頭跟著器械走，不是跟著我的脾氣走。
lines.en: You hold the camera. It follows the instruments, not my temper.

guide.en: Establish the critical view of safety

lines.zh: 停。安全關鍵視野三個條件，說。
lines.en: Stop. The three conditions of the critical view of safety. Go.

lines.zh: 肝膽三角清乾淨；膽囊下三分之一離開肝床；只有兩條結構進膽囊。
lines.en: Triangle cleared; lower third of the gallbladder off the liver bed; only two structures entering it.

lines.zh: 三條都有，才剪。沒有，就不剪。
lines.en: All three, then cut. Not all three, no cutting.

post.en: Wait. This one is thicker than it should be.

post.zh: 這是膽囊管，還是總膽管？
post.en: Is that the cystic duct, or the common bile duct?

post.zh: 不確定就不夾。退一步，換角度再剝離；還不行就膽道攝影或轉開腹。
post.en: Not sure, don't clip. Step back, change the angle, dissect again; if still unsure, cholangiogram or conversion to open.

post.zh: 多剝離幾分鐘後，真正的膽囊管從後面出現了。
post.en: A few more minutes of dissection and the real cystic duct appears from behind.

post.zh: 你那個問題問出來，就救了一條膽管。
post.en: Asking that question just saved a bile duct.

lines.zh: 最後清點。
lines.en: Final count.

lines.zh: 紗布十、針三、夾子數對。標本：膽囊一個，福馬林。
lines.en: Swabs ten, needles three, clips accounted for. Specimen: one gallbladder, in formalin.

lines.zh: 標本袋上姓名、病歷號、部位寫完整再送。
lines.en: Name, record number and site complete on the specimen bag before it goes.

guide.en: Check on Mrs Wang in recovery

lines.zh: 醫師……開完了？
lines.en: Doctor... is it over?

lines.zh: 開完了，膽囊很乖地出來了。
lines.en: It's over. The gallbladder came out very politely.

lines.zh: 那我明天……
lines.en: So tomorrow...

lines.zh: 明天再說。先睡。
lines.en: Tomorrow we'll talk. Sleep now.

note.zh: 12 床膽管炎，沒有等到明天
note.en: Bed 12 cholangitis: did not wait for tomorrow

sub.zh: 12 床發燒、黃疸、血壓往下掉

guide.en: Take the call and hurry to bed 12

lines.zh: 醫師，12 床總膽管結石等 ERCP 那位，發燒畏寒，皮膚更黃，血壓往下掉。
lines.en: Doctor, bed 12, the bile-duct stone waiting for ERCP: fever and rigors, more jaundiced, blood pressure dropping.

lines.zh: 收到。兩套血液培養先抽，依醫囑輸液，我馬上到。
lines.en: Got it. Two sets of blood cultures now, fluids per protocol, I'm on my way.

options.zh: 血液培養、依醫囑輸液與抗生素、通知主治
options.en: Cultures, fluids and antibiotics per protocol, call the attending

why.zh: 敗血症路徑：培養先抽，抗生素與輸液依醫囑，上級要知道。
why.en: Sepsis pathway: cultures first, antibiotics and fluids per protocol, and the senior must know.

options.zh: 先退燒，觀察到明天早上

why.zh: 發燒、黃疸加低血壓不是「觀察」的組合。
why.en: Fever, jaundice and hypotension are not a 'watch and wait' combination.

options.zh: 直接推去開刀房開膽囊
options.en: Straight to theatre for the gallbladder

why.zh: 問題在膽管不在膽囊。先復甦，再引流膽管。
why.en: The problem is the duct, not the gallbladder. Resuscitate first, then drain the duct.

lines.zh: 發燒、黃疸、右上腹痛，加上低血壓。膽管炎，而且在惡化。
lines.en: Fever, jaundice, right upper quadrant pain, plus hypotension. Cholangitis, and getting worse.

lines.zh: 膽管炎要什麼？
lines.en: What does cholangitis need?

lines.zh: 引流。今晚就聯絡消化科做 ERCP，不等明天。
lines.en: Drainage. Call gastroenterology for an ERCP tonight, not tomorrow.

lines.zh: 對。這種病人不等明天。
lines.en: Right. This patient does not wait for tomorrow.

note.zh: 交給夜班，師傅的三件事
note.en: Handed to the night team; the mentor's three things

guide.zh: 用 ISBAR 向夜班交班
guide.en: Hand over to the night team in ISBAR

lines.zh: 小宇術後，根部壞死已處理。王阿姨術後，順利。12 床膽管炎，今晚 ERCP。
lines.en: Yu post-op, necrotic base dealt with. Mrs Wang post-op, uneventful. Bed 12 cholangitis, ERCP tonight.

lines.zh: 7 床呢？
lines.en: And bed 7?

lines.zh: 導尿後舒服了，問能不能回家煮飯。
lines.en: Comfortable after the catheter; asking if he can go home and cook.

lines.zh: 全院都想回家煮飯。收到。
lines.en: The whole hospital wants to go home and cook. Received.

guide.en: Dr Kai asks about the base

lines.zh: 早上你本來想用套圈綁壞死根部？
lines.en: This morning you wanted to loop the necrotic base?

lines.zh: 對。林主治改成縫合器切在健康盲腸壁。
lines.en: I did. Dr Lin switched to stapling across healthy caecal wall.

lines.zh: 好。那今晚我會多看他一次肚子。
lines.en: Fine. Then I'll check his abdomen once more tonight.

lines.zh: 今天三件事。闌尾根部，你有停下來看。
lines.en: Three things today. The appendix base: you stopped and looked.

lines.zh: 膽囊那條粗的結構，你有問。膽管炎，你沒等。
lines.en: The thick structure in the gallbladder: you asked. The cholangitis: you didn't wait.

lines.zh: 咖啡你一口都沒喝。
lines.en: You never touched your coffee.

lines.zh: 明天再喝。去吃飯。
lines.en: Tomorrow. Go and eat.

note.en: The truth about the shoulder pain

sub.en: Yu says his right shoulder hurts

lines.zh: 醫師，小宇說右肩膀痛，很緊張，問是不是開壞了。
lines.en: Doctor, Yu says his right shoulder hurts. He's anxious, asking if the operation went wrong.

lines.zh: 呼吸、血壓、傷口都好嗎？
lines.en: Breathing, pressure and wound all fine?

lines.zh: 都正常。就是肩膀。
lines.en: All normal. Just the shoulder.

q.zh: 腹腔鏡術後第一晚的肩膀痛，最可能是？
q.en: Shoulder pain on the first night after laparoscopy is most likely...?

options.zh: 氣腹殘留的氣體刺激橫膈膜的轉移痛
options.en: Referred pain from leftover gas irritating the diaphragm

why.zh: 對。氣腹的二氧化碳刺激橫膈，痛會轉移到肩膀，走動、翻身會好。
why.en: Right. Carbon dioxide from the pneumoperitoneum irritates the diaphragm; the pain refers to the shoulder and settles with moving about.

options.en: Heart attack, call the arrest team

why.zh: 19 歲、生命徵象正常、腹腔鏡剛做完——先想最常見的。評估，不要嚇病人。
why.en: Nineteen, normal vitals, fresh laparoscopy: think of the common thing first. Assess, don't frighten him.

options.zh: 叫他別想太多，明天再說
options.en: Tell him not to overthink it

why.zh: 病人害怕的時候，解釋就是治療。去看他。
why.en: When a patient is scared, an explanation is treatment. Go and see him.

lines.zh: 醫師，我肩膀痛……是不是你們開到什麼？
lines.en: Doctor, my shoulder hurts... did you cut something you shouldn't have?

lines.zh: 是氣腹留下的氣體刺激橫膈膜，痛會跑到肩膀。走一走、翻個身就會好。
lines.en: It's the gas left from the pneumoperitoneum irritating your diaphragm; the pain travels to the shoulder. Walk a little, turn over, it settles.

lines.zh: 那……期中考？
lines.en: So... mid-terms?

lines.zh: 睡覺。
lines.en: Sleep.

lines.zh: 走廊安靜下來。手機震了一下。
lines.en: The corridor goes quiet. Your phone buzzes.

lines.zh: 一台闌尾，一台膽囊，一個膽管炎，一個肩膀。今天也算學會了一些事。
lines.en: One appendix, one gallbladder, one cholangitis, one shoulder. Learned a few things today.

lines.zh: 值班結束。桌上的咖啡，明天會換一杯新的。
lines.en: End of shift. Tomorrow there will be a fresh coffee on the desk.

sub.zh: 簡單的闌尾，從來不簡單
